Meeting Minutes: 
The president Sri Dr N Sudhakar Reddy, welcomed all the IIC council members for the Third Council 
Meeting. IIC President given a brief overview of activities under IIC, MIC, Celebration Day and Self-
driven activities to be organized under Quarter-3. 
Agenda: 
1. Review of IIC7.0 Quarter-3 activities  
2. IIC Calendar Activities 
3. MIC Driven Activities 
4. Self-Driven Activities 
5. Celebration Day Activities 
6. Guiding Students for YUKTI, PENTHATHON, HACKATHONS etc  
7. Any additional points with the permission of IIC president

Agenda Point 1: IIC Team reviewed the IIC7.0 Quarter-3 activities 
Resolution: Members explained about IIC7.0 Quarter-3 events outcomes and IIC President suggested 
the Members to focus more activities related to Innovation and entrepreneurship with student centric. 
Agenda Point 2: IIC discussed to prepare Calendar Activities for the Quarter 4.  
Resolution: Prepared Calendar Activities for the Quarter 4 and approved by IIC President and other 
Members.   
Agenda Point 3: IIC Council discussed to prepare MIC Calendar Activities for the Quarter 4.  
Resolution: Prepared MIC Calendar Activities for the Quarter 4 and approved by IIC President and 
IIC Members.  
Agenda Point 4: IIC Council discussed to prepare Self Driven Activities for the Quarter 4.  
Resolution: Prepared Self Driven Activities for the Quarter 4 and it was approved by IIC President 
and IIC Members.  
Agenda Point 5: IIC Council discussed to prepare Celebration Day Activities for the Quarter 4.  
Resolution: Prepared Celebration Day Activities  for the Quarter 4 and it was approved by IIC 
President and IIC Members.  
Agenda Point 6: IIC Council discussed to conduct programs to encourage student participation in 
National Level competitions during Quarter 4.  
Resolution: Prepared plan of action to drive student to participate in hackathons during the Quarter 4 
and it was approved by IIC President and IIC Members.  
Agenda Point 5: IIC Council discussed to organize events to encourage students towards Innovation, 
start-ups and entrepreneur skills.  
Resolution: Prepared activities on IPR/Innovation/Entrepreneurship skills for the Quarter 4 and it 
was approved by IIC President and IIC Members.
